##### Project general facts

The Wilds by Aldar is a nature-led villa community where homes are designed to live as part of nature rather than apart from it. The community brings together Cassia Villas with three to five bedrooms, Ravenna Residences with four and five bedrooms, a majlis and driver's room, and a rare collection of five- and six-bedroom Moringa Mansions designed by Nabil Gholam Architects. Homes rise from a ground floor to one or three upper floors, and the mansions add a basement and a private rooftop terrace.

Amenities are inspired by the natural world. Nature trails lead to a central park with natural pools and streams, The Spring splash pad, a kids' adventure playground, The Nest Signature Pavilion and restorative and community gardens. Residents enjoy a health club, a sanctuary spa, a yoga deck, tennis, padel, basketball and multi-use courts and a cycle track, together with The Observatory for stargazing, The Lookout for bird watching, bee conservation and an organic food market.

Interiors are available in light and dark colour schemes, with family rooms, maid's rooms and preparation kitchens in every home, while larger residences add a majlis and driver's room. Generous windows bring in natural light and frame views of the landscaped gardens and the central park. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, and a la carte services include butler and housekeeping services, pet care, senior care, renovation assistance and landscape and gardening support.

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa is a green residential district in the south of Dubai, neighbouring Majan and the green neighbourhoods of Al Barari. Nature trails, native landscaped gardens, a central park, natural pools and streams and themed gardens shape a calm setting where native wildlife thrives, while community retail and a world-class school serve families close to home and create a peaceful setting away from busy city streets.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road runs alongside the community, providing quick access across the city. IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village and Hamdan Sports Complex are a short drive away, while Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, Business Bay, Dubai International Airport and Dubai Marina are within comfortable driving distance, together with Dubai Hills and Arabian Ranches, keeping shopping, dining and leisure within easy reach.

Wadi Al Safa offers freehold communities designed to LEED and Fitwel standards, offering a rare combination of biophilic design, privacy and central connectivity. Nature-focused communities with generous open spaces are in limited supply in Dubai, supporting strong demand from families and end users. The backing of a leading developer and a growing lifestyle offer underpin long-term value for owners and investors.
